datasetFingerprints.name: Canonical RAG & Grounded Retrieval Evaluation Dataset

datasetFingerprints.name: Multimodal Ingestion & Robustness Benchmark Dataset

datasetFingerprints.name: Authoritative Assessment Verifier & Quality Dataset

datasetFingerprints.name: Chronological Synthetic Learner Trace Calibration Dataset
